sources.entry: HappySRT - Generate SRT Files for youtube using AI Technology #freemium

summary.name: HappySRT
summary.one_liner: HappySRT is an open-source web app that transcribes audio or video into timestamped text and SRT subtitles, translates it into other languages, and generates summaries.
use_cases: Generate SRT subtitle files for YouTube videos
Translate subtitle tracks into other languages
Summarize long audio or video content
Organize transcription projects in separate threads
summary.what_it_does:
HappySRT lets you upload an audio or video file, or paste a media URL, inside a thread. You can run transcription, which produces text with timestamps that can be exported as SRT, and translation, which generates subtitle tracks in a target language. Summarization produces highlights, bullets, and quick notes. Actions can be run individually or chained, and results appear in Transcription, Translation, and Summary tabs. Results can be copied or downloaded as SRT or text.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">freemium
notable: Chains transcription, translation, and summarization in one thread
Guest mode with Google sign-in for syncing threads
caveats: Uses a token-based processing system; higher limits require upgrading to a paid plan
Larger files consume more processing tokens
Embedded media may be blocked in some environments
